messages:
Nina Patel: @here quick 2-min poll — what should go in the next WFH care package? react with emoji to vote (or reply)

Options:
• 🍫 :chocolate_bar: Dark chocolate
• 🥜 :peanuts: Nut/seed mix
• 🥭 :mango: Dried fruit (mango/apricot)
• 🍪 :cookie: Bite-size cookies
• 🧃 :juice: Shelf-stable drinks (tea/juice)
• 🧋 :bubble_tea: Fun kit (boba or specialty tea)

Vote with emoji or drop a comment. I'll close on Friday and share results! :smile:

Carlos M.: 🍫 all the way. dark chocolate > everything :raised_hands:

Devon K: 🥭 dried mango please. less crumbs for the keyboard :sweat_smile:

Sophie L: 🍪 tiny cookies. bribery for morale. :cookie:

Jen (People Ops): @Nina Patel can we do 2 items? maybe chocolate + nut mix for variety? :thinking_face:

Carlos M.: +1 to combo. also can we add a note: "no kale chips" — pls spare us :pleading_face:

Devon K: 🥜 I vote for combo too. protein bars would be okay but people hate them apparently :grimacing:

Sophie L: 🍫 + 🥭 is a vibe.

ops-bot: Poll tally (interim) — reactions collected so far:
```
🍫 7
🥜 3
🥭 5
🍪 4
🧃 1
🧋 2
```

Nina Patel: awesome — looks like chocolate and dried fruit are leading. will finalize by Friday and share order link. thanks y'all! :sparkles:

Carlos M.: hell yes :chocolate_bar::tada:

Jen (People Ops): I'll budget for a small allergy-friendly option too (nut-free alternative).

Sophie L: can we include a tiny note for timezone-friendly snacks? low perishables only pls.

Nina Patel: noted — shelf-stable + nut-free option included. final order on Friday, shipping for WFH folks and office drop for in-office. :package:
